scope: Bounded direct-source corpus reconstructed through 2026-09-04 from the supplied setup inventory, sanitized direct dependency and container declarations, local extension records, current kit configuration, and primary public repositories. Historical application code and prose, private repositories, and transitive packages are excluded.

historical_evidence: sanitized direct dependency and lockfile declarations
local extension manifests and attribution records
excluded: ambient operating-system shells and base copy, search, and directory utilities; these are cited through vendor or platform documentation rather than reconstructed as repository dependencies
credentials, sessions, caches, and workstation paths

license_notice: License labels are discovery aids, not legal advice. NOASSERTION means no reliable repository-wide license was established during this audit; it does not mean public-domain or unrestricted use.
